content.about: Sweden is a long Nordic country in northern Europe, with forests, lakes and a coast of many islands. Its north has reindeer herding and the midnight sun. It is known for design, music and the Nobel Prizes. Stockholm is built on 14 islands.

standout.text: The Icehotel in Jukkasjärvi was the world's first hotel built entirely of ice and snow.

didYouKnow: Alfred Nobel, who founded the Nobel Prizes, was Swedish.
Anyone may walk and camp on most land under the "right of public access".
